children: ACG Metals updated its Gediktepe CPR, lifting project NPV to $1.2B. The sulphide plant targets 1.8Mtpa throughput and payable output averaging 36ktpa CuEq in 2027–2031, with an Enriched Ore Project start targeted for Q3 2027.

Gediktepe NPV now $1.2B
Higher NPV can re-rate valuation; implies stronger project economics and longevity.
Sulphide plant 1.8Mtpa, 72% Cu rec
Throughput and recoveries set production cost curve and cash flow potential.
36ktpa CuEq avg 2027–2031
Defines medium-term production profile; key for revenue modeling.
Enriched Ore start Q3 2027
Brings forward concurrent Au/Ag and Cu/Zn output; diversifies cash flows.
Enriched Ore capex $60.4M
Sets funding needs and timeline risk; manageable if cash flows ramp.
Heap leach extended beyond 2026
Extends Au production tail; supports near-term cash while sulphides ramp.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a mid-cycle upgrade, converting a short-life oxide mine into a multi-stream copper-focused operation with defined ramp-up. For a larger catalyst, ACG must hit ramp-up targets, deliver Q3 2027 enriched ore start, and confirm recoveries and costs in line with the CPR.
